mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Knight of the Ebon Legion
# 1. "{2}{B}: This creature gets +3/+3 and gains deathtouch until end of turn."
#    The activated self-pump (B3-modify-pt-self, Masked Blackguard "{2}{B}: This creature gets
#    +1/+1 until end of turn.") and self-grant (B3-grant-kw-self, Fetid Imp "{B}: This creature
#    gains deathtouch until end of turn.") as one Seq, MODIFY_PT then GRANT_ABILITY (the order of
#    Sure Strike / Dire Fleet Warmonger's "gets +N/+N and gains K until end of turn").
# 2. "At the beginning of your end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, put a +1/+1
#    counter on this creature."  Frame + condition: `parse "At the beginning of your end step, if a
#    player lost 4 or more life this turn, draw a card."`; effect: Scion of the Swarm's
#    PUT_COUNTER on the source.
this_creature = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
    filter=FAnd(
        children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        ),
    ),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
pump = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(
        parts=(
            CostManaColor(color='B', amount=QConst(value=1)),
            CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=2)),
        ),
    ),
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=3)),
                'target': this_creature,
                'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=3)),
            }),
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.DEATHTOUCH),
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'target': this_creature,
            }),
        ),
    ),
)
end_step_counter = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.END_TURN,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.EVENT_THIS_TURN,
        count=QConst(value=4),
        event=LifeLostEvent(),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [pump, end_step_counter, *compiled]

clauses.clause: {2}{B}: This creature gets +3/+3 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mapping.notes: Activated: Seq of the B3 self-pump (Masked Blackguard) and B3 self-grant (Fetid Imp), same self selector. End step: parse of '... if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, draw a card.' gives the frame and EVENT_THIS_TURN(LifeLostEvent(), count 4) (one player's total); effect is Scion of the Swarm's PUT_COUNTER. Self-check packs (scratch): 4 to one player -> counter, 3 -> none, 2+2 from two attackers -> counter, pump +3/+3 and deathtouch end at cleanup.

clauses.clause: At the beginning of your end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: Probe: [turns pass: your end step ...] no life lost -> no counter (only the false case). Tree: END_TURN actor YOU, EVENT_THIS_TURN LifeLostEvent count 4 (the IR's documented 'a player lost 4 or more life' reading: summed within one player). Packs (live tree, all pass, each flipped twin fails): knight_1 Shock P1 twice (2+2) -> counter; knight_2 one Shock at each player -> none; knight_3 4/4 unblocked (4 in one hit) -> counter; knight_4 3 damage -> none; knight_5 P0 Shocks itself twice -> counter; knight_6 P0 loses 4 on P1's turn -> no counter at P1's end step.
